translation: Once the dharma that had manifested in Goriyad kindled the love to sing its glory, Jivanji Maharaj moved on from there to Shahpura, to live in the presence of Sant Gopaldas, and spent nearly his entire life there — living in Puniyad only for the last seven years. In this Shahpura he established the Uda tradition (dharma), and his samagam (satsang record) too was kept there in worship; in Samvat 1931 the revered Fulba brought it to Puniyad. Thus this Shahpura, as the field of Jivanji's life's work (karmabhoomi), is a sacred and holy place.
